idea-plugin.name: Easy Request
idea-plugin.description: A project-local HTTP client for IntelliJ IDEA with preview and fixed request tabs. Browse Java Spring Controllers in a separate, manually refreshed API tree with Swagger names. Automatically persist Controller endpoints and incrementally refresh their catalog without overwriting saved parameters. Save request changes directly to the catalog and use stars to bookmark the same records in folders. Keep removed source endpoints and their settings, marked as missing from source. View read-only parameter comments from Swagger annotations and Java field documentation. Organize saved requests into folders, switch URL prefixes, share headers, and open Java Spring MVC endpoints directly from the editor with generated request examples.
